meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器代理调用本地大模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让容器中的智能体调用本地运行的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会多出两个工具:列出 Atomic Chat 里当前可用的本地模型,以及把提示发给指定模型并取回回答。模型本身要在 Atomic Chat 桌面应用里下载和管理。
howto.when: 当你要求用本地模型回答,或提到 atomic_chat_generate 等工具名时触发。前提是 Atomic Chat 桌面应用已装好、其本地 API 服务已在 1337 端口运行。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都是哪里
say.note: 会先列出可用模型,再生成回答

say.text: 先列出 Atomic Chat 里有哪些模型
用 atomic_chat_generate 让本地模型回答:你好
say.note: 把提示发给该模型并返回结果

howto.what_en: After install, Claude gains two tools: list the local models currently available in Atomic Chat, and send a prompt to a chosen model and return its reply. Models are downloaded and managed in the Atomic Chat desktop app.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to use a local model, or mention tools like atomic_chat_generate. Requires the Atomic Chat desktop app installed with its local API server running on port 1337.

say_en.text: Use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: It lists models first, then generates a reply

say_en.text: List the models available in Atomic Chat
Use atomic_chat_generate with a local model to answer: hi
say_en.note: Sends the prompt to that model and returns its reply
